name: Video Tools
desc: Panel transcripts, joining clips and cutting clips.

pages.name: Panel Transcript
pages.desc: Turn a clip into a strip of subtitled stills.
pages.about: Upload a clip with people talking: it picks a still for each line, writes down what’s said and stacks the stills into one image with the lines as subtitles. You name the speakers before it’s made.

pages.name: Join Clips
pages.desc: Join clips end to end, with fades if you like.
pages.about: Put several clips together into one video. Clips that match are joined in seconds without losing quality; add fades or crossfades, or mix phones and cameras, and it converts them to one format first.

pages.name: Cut a Clip
pages.desc: Cut a stretch out of a longer video.
pages.about: Pick a start and an end and get just that part: an exact MP4 that plays on any phone (HDR colours fixed), or a fast copy in the original quality.
